# Weft 1.1.20
- Keep managed project services, logs, routing connections, shared services, and data services in a private runtime that survives app updates. - Reconnect after a Sparkle relaunch without starting duplicate services. Normal Quit still stops managed services. - Bound failed handoffs and reject incompatible or unauthenticated runtime connections.
The first upgrade from an earlier version still needs one restart to move service ownership into the new runtime. Install this version when your current work can pause; subsequent updates use the handoff.
